verdict.rationale: The evidence never publishes an up-front list of the account, credential, or identity-proofing steps required before a founder can file an entity registration. sam-gov-docs-19 only says "Register your entity… to get started" without naming any prerequisites. The documented account tiers, System Account approval, and API-key retrieval cover read access to the Entity Management API, an adjacent capability rather than the filing path, so they earn no credit here.
